tools.name: understand_physical_problem
tools.description: Builds the canonical PhysicalProblem, Observation Graph and explicit unknown set from the supplied description.

tools.name: get_next_observation
tools.description: Returns the single highest-value missing observation without promoting hypotheses to facts.

tools.name: generate_hypotheses
tools.description: Explores candidate transformations from the same PhysicalProblem and labels every unverified candidate as HYPOTHESIS.

tools.name: search_candidates
tools.description: Searches the verified local index for candidates; a candidate is never presented as an identified product without evidence.

tools.name: synthesize_physical_solution
tools.description: Runs the canonical resolver and returns either a supported solution or the next required observation.

tools.name: verify_solution
tools.description: Checks a proposed candidate independently against the canonical constraints and reports verification separately from generation.

tools.name: generate_artifact
tools.description: Generates only LIVE deterministic formats after plan acceptance and verification; STEP remains unavailable.

tools.name: get_verified_commerce_options
tools.description: Returns discovery candidates separately from RevenueGuard-approved monetizable offers and enforces distribution rights per surface.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Searches the verified local product and part-type index without inventing identities.

tools.name: resolve_problem
tools.description: Runs the deterministic problem-first resolver and returns the best supported next action or the minimum missing information.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one canonical ProductTwin and its source-level provenance by stable identifier.

tools.name: get_compatibility
tools.description: Compares two canonical ProductTwins. It reports direct compatibility only when their verified interface system matches.

tools.name: get_fit_guidance
tools.description: Calculates deterministic manufacturing compensation and returns an explicit physical-test warning.

tools.name: list_generation_options
tools.description: Lists only generator families implemented by the current deterministic core.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility adapter. Returns provider discovery only; use get_verified_commerce_options for separated verified output.
